title: 希耶尔 · 摘下眼镜的慌乱娇羞
description: 黄昏的社团活动室里，希耶尔的眼镜已经折好放在书桌上。少了镜片的遮挡，她对上你近在眼前的目光，蓝色眼眸里浮起惊讶，耳根一点点变红。她穿着整齐的藏青校服外套和灰色百褶裙，双手轻轻攥住你递来的衣袖，想要说些什么，又先露出难为情的浅笑。
location: 夕阳斜照的无人社团活动室书桌旁
action: 摘下的眼镜放在桌上，双手抓住视角衣袖，抬眼露出惊讶而害羞的浅笑。
camera: medium close-up, eye level, sleeve in foreground
promptProse: Folded glasses rest on the clubroom desk beside Ciel, leaving her sapphire eyes unobstructed when she looks up at the viewer. She wears a neat navy blazer, white shirt, red tie and grey pleated skirt. Both hands gather the cuff of the sleeve entering the foreground, and surprise settles into a small embarrassed smile. Warm sunset light touches her short blue hair and reddened ears. Keep her uncovered face and the two hands in a medium close view; the glasses remain on the desk.

title: 两仪式 · 伽蓝之堂的膝枕休憩
description: 午后的光穿过伽蓝之堂的百叶窗，落在复古沙发上。两仪式已经把红夹克挂在远处的衣帽架，穿整齐的白色和服侧卧在沙发上，把头安静地枕在你的膝上。她一手放松地搭在自己腰间，另一手蜷在脸旁，眼睛微阖，嘴角只有一点不易察觉的安宁。百叶窗的光斑慢慢移过靠垫，屋里只剩安静的呼吸声。
location: 摆放着人偶与古董的伽蓝之堂事务所沙发
action: 穿白和服侧卧沙发，头枕视角膝上闭眼休息，双手自然放松。
camera: medium shot, slightly high angle, resting face and supporting lap
promptProse: Across the old leather sofa in Garan no Dou, Ryougi Shiki rests on her side with her head on the viewer's clothed lap. Her white kimono stays neatly overlapped beneath a dark obi; a distant coat stand marks the edge of the quiet room. One hand rests at her waist and the other curls beside her cheek. Eyes almost closed, she wears a barely visible peaceful smile. Afternoon stripes from the blinds cross the cushions. The supporting lap enters at the lower edge of the portrait.

title: 两仪式 · 幽雪两仪的真白无垢
description: 两仪家冬日庭院积着薄雪，古松与竹影围住安静的木廊。两仪式换上纯白无垢，角隐覆在短发上，织纹在雪地反光中若隐若现。她把双手端正交叠在腹前，向廊下的你微微躬身，平日冷静的神情里多了一点羞意。她抬眼时露出克制而认真的微笑，雪光映亮了角隐的边缘。
location: 两仪家大宅白雪覆盖的枯山水古庭长廊前
action: 穿白无垢和角隐站在雪庭木廊前，双手交叠腹前微微行礼，再抬眼浅笑。
camera: medium full shot, eye level, formal bridal portrait
promptProse: White silk catches the reflected snow light as Ryougi Shiki bows slightly before the wooden veranda of the Ryougi estate. She wears a complete shiromuku and white tsunokakushi, with both hands folded neatly at her waist. Her short black hair frames a restrained, bashful smile as she raises her eyes toward the viewer. Frosted bamboo and an old pine enclose the quiet courtyard. The formal white layers and folded hands define this quiet portrait.

title: 结城明日奈 · 22层木屋的暖心早餐·「快趁热吃吧，特制的三明治烤好了哦！」
description: 第22层湖畔木屋里，晨光把原木餐桌照得暖暖的。亚丝娜穿米白毛衣和粉色花围裙，双手稳稳托着木餐盘走向你，盘上是刚烤好的厚切三明治，热茶已经放在餐桌上。栗色侧辫垂在肩旁，她在桌边停下，先看你的表情，再露出轻快的笑。
location: 第22层两人购置的湖畔森林木屋厨房
action: 双手端木托盘送来热三明治，在原木餐桌旁停步微笑。
camera: medium shot, eye level, breakfast tray in foreground
promptProse: Fresh grilled sandwiches arrive on a wooden tray held securely in both of Asuna Yuuki's hands. She has stopped beside the timber dining table in the sunny Floor 22 cabin, wearing a cream sweater and pink floral apron above a navy skirt. Her chestnut side braid rests over her shoulder as she waits for the viewer's reaction with a bright smile. A teacup is already on the table beside her. Morning light from the lake-facing window picks out the toasted bread and rising steam.

title: 结城明日奈 · 湖畔微风下的草地膝枕·「真是的……像小猫一样睡得这么香呢」
description: 22层湖畔的柳树筛下细碎光斑，亚丝娜坐在野餐布上，让你安静地枕着她的膝盖。她换了米白针织衫和柔软的藏青裙，一只手托着脸颊，另一手轻轻拨开你的额发。你从膝上睁开眼时，先看见她低头的笑脸，再看见她身后的柳叶和明亮湖水。树叶轻轻摇动，让光斑在她的笑脸旁缓缓移动。
location: 22层湖畔避世古树阴凉下的草坪
action: 坐在野餐布上提供膝枕，一手托腮，另一手轻拨视角额发，低头温柔微笑。
camera: POV close-up from the resting lap, looking upward
promptProse: Looking upward from the lap pillow, the viewer meets Asuna Yuuki's gentle smile beneath the willow leaves. She sits on a picnic blanket in a cream round-neck sweater and navy skirt, resting her cheek on one hand while the other brushes the viewer's fringe at the lower edge of the picture. Sparkling lake water and filtered afternoon light remain behind her face. The close perspective follows the resting viewer's gaze into the gently moving leaves.
